_why: The exact wizard inputs the fixtures under fixtures/llm/setup_*/ were recorded from. Every fixture key is a sha over the assembled prompt, and the descriptor and these three free-text fields are spliced into every one of them -- so a replay that retypes them by hand misses every fixture. Read the inputs from here; never restate them.

descriptor.tagline: AI-industry intelligence: research, score, graph, brief.
descriptor.login_blurb: venona runs a research pipeline over the AI trade press and keeps what it learns.

generate.persona: An analyst at a venture firm covering the AI infrastructure and model-developer market. Reads to keep track of who is building what, which labs and chip vendors are tied to which customers, and where capital and compute are moving.
generate.priorities: Model releases and capability claims; compute and chip supply; funding rounds and acquisitions; safety and regulation that changes what can ship.
generate.seeds: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google DeepMind, Nvidia, Mistral

recorded.note: fixtures/llm/setup_*/ hold the envelopes. The dossier beside this file is the survey stage's stored output: replay MUST preload it, because the survey prompt gets `Today's date: ...` appended only when live, so a live-recorded setup_survey envelope is keyed on a prompt an offline run never assembles.
